description: Consumo eléctrico 2018-2022 is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Valencia. Value in kiloWatios / hour i in euros of the consumption d'electricitat a València, desglossat per mesos (from 2018 to 2022), i també, desglossat en el consumit en col·legis, enllumenat públic i dependències (quantitat d'energia that is necessary to import per to be able to provide-se in form d'electricitat). Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Valencia. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity consumption 2018-2022" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Valencia. Its keywords include alumbrado, colegio, dependencias, dependències. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHEET. The listing shows 2026-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
